relations.statement: first count n for run r: a demand stands at prefix length n and no prefix of length m<n carries a demand
relations.hypotheses: arbitrary run; demand predicate on prefixes

lemmas.statement: If n and m are both first counts for the same run, then n = m, with no decidability hypothesis
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem first_demand_unique {P : Nat → Prop} {n m : Nat} (hn : P n ∧ ∀ k < n, ¬ P k) (hm : P m ∧ ∀ k < m, ¬ P k) : n = m := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy n m with h | h | h
  · exact absurd hm.1 (by exact fun _ => hm.2 n h hn.1)
  · exact h
  · exact absurd hn.1 (fun _ => hn.2 m h hm.1)
